entries.english:
Enfeoffment of the von Roggenbach family with the wine and grain revenues at Wasenweiler formerly belonging to the Münch von Rosenberg family.

Term: (1418) 1706–1727

Contents include a renewed register of rents and dues. Included within it is a sketch of a von Roggenbach family tree.

Term: 1709–1727
